note: Weapon-in-hand placement, as coded in fox-kit.js (search "gear ==="). Positions are local to the arm group (shoulder pivot), metres; the fox is ~1.6 m tall.

sword.rotationEachFrame: x = 0.95 - arm.rotation.x, y = 0, z = -0.5 (blade stays level while the arm swings)
sword.blade: emissive pulse 0.4..2.0 at 3.2 rad/s; colour lerps white → armorAccent

town: In the town square the player carries the sword holstered-look (gear sword); melee/range buttons only toast there.
